exposure: SUD sample vs. general psychiatric sample
cohort: Adolescent participants (n = 102) from two study centers, one for SUD patients (n = 51) and one for general psychopathology (n = 51), matched for age, gender, and specific pattern of comorbid disorders
finding: Perinatal markers (mode of birth, weeks of completed pregnancy, birth weight, Apgar score after 5 min) were not able to distinguish SUD patients from patients with diverse psychopathologies.
mod_finding: While not a primary finding, C-section birth was associated with a small increase in the probability of belonging to the general psychiatric sample instead of the SUD sample.
